review:
The Aztec crew on a 6x5 pay-anywhere grid. Match enough symbols anywhere and you win; winning symbols vanish and the board refills, so chains happen.

The multipliers only show up in free spins. Each one lands with a random value from 2x to 100x, stays until the refill sequence ends, then they all add together and hit that sequence's total. Chance x2 makes four scatters more likely. High volatility, 10,200x max, 96.11% RTP. Be patient – free spins average roughly once every 398 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
